CustomField.description: Optional. API name of a lookup field on Form_Submission__c that points back to this source object (e.g., FlowToolKit__Campaign__c). When set, the source record Id is stamped on the submission via this lookup in addition to Source_Id__c. Useful for reports, list views, and platform event conversion flows. Source_Id__c is always populated regardless of this setting.
CustomField.label: Source Lookup Field
